articles.title: OmniAnalytics BI: Executive Decision Support System Built with Streamlit and Plotly
articles.summary: 1. Introduction: The Era of Data-Driven Decision Making In the modern enterprise landscape, data is the most strategic asset of any organization; however, raw data lacks intrinsic value without context and interpretability. The primary objective of Business Intelligence (BI) is to transform transactional volumes into actionable intelligence, enabling executive leaders and operations directors to answer critical business questions: Which product categories and channels generate the highest net operating margin? How would a 5% price increase or a 10% operating cost contraction impact our EBITDA? Which customer segments yield the highest customer lifetime value (CLV) and purchase frequency? Historically, developing executive control cockpits relied either on heavy proprietary software suites (such as Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik) or complex full-stack web applications built on React/Angular paired with Django/FastAPI microservices. articles.title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to build AI agents that speed up drug development
articles.summary: OpenAI is acquiring startup Orchestra Bio and plans to merge it with its life sciences AI platform Rosalind. The goal is to build AI agents that help pharma teams coordinate drug development, from tracking trials to spotting problems. Developing a new drug in the US takes ten to 15 years on average. OpenAI already works with Novo Nordisk and Moderna on AI-driven pharma research. articles.title: The AI IPO Wave Is The Dot-Com Bubble’s Evil Twin. Anthropic’s Delay Just Proved It.
articles.summary: In this guest article from Airrived co-founder and CEO Anurag Gurtu, he contends that Anthropic’s rapid revenue growth does not justify its proposed $2 trillion IPO valuation, given enormous infrastructure commitments, safety concerns, customer concentration and competition from cheaper open-weight models, saying instead that lasting enterprise AI value will come from proprietary data, reliable deployment and measurable customer outcomes rather than expensive models alone.
